rows.prompt: Photoreal space footage. A single elongated, peanut-shaped rocky asteroid, grey-brown, rough and cratered with scattered boulders, fills most of the vertical frame and is already tumbling slowly end over end as it sweeps from upper right towards lower left. Hard white sunlight from the left gives a sharp terminator and deep shadows; the dark side falls to black. The background is pure, empty black with no stars and nothing else in frame. The rock has clearly turned by the first second and keeps rotating steadily. Smooth, steady camera, slight drift. Silent.
